entities.summary: Ludwig van Beethoven was a German composer and pianist. He emerged in the Classical period, then expanded on what he was taught to incorporate more complex musical structure and emotional expression. His musical style was central to the development of Romantic music and the expansion of forms such as the symphony and string quartet. His works continue to attract both casual and scholarly interest, and he is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential composers in the history of music.
